reason: I know my regulars by name, I don't need an app to tell me who comes back, and loyalty rewards are a chain thing. Right now I'm two waiters short and the last thing I have time for is setting up another system next to Wox and the terminal.
objection: I already pay for a POS and a card terminal, and now there's another per-transaction fee on top plus guests leaving dish ratings that can hurt me. Why add a third system?
would_change_my_mind: If another Tbilisi owner I trust showed me QR pay-at-table actually saves waiter time on a busy night and doesn't cost more in fees than my terminal, I'd try the free 3 months.
